description:
I would like to repair or replace some of the existing sash box frames within the flat to address ongoing wear and tear - three of the five windows are in need of complete replacing as they are dormer windows and have been exposed to all the elements of the weather. The windows to be replaced are beyond economical repair and their current condition may lead to weather-tightness issues and water ingress if no action is taken. The remaining two windows require repairs, but replacement is not required.

I would also like to improve the energy efficiency of the property by installing slimline heritage double-glazed timber sashes into the repaired/replaced sash box frames. The existing (moving) sashes will be replaced with new timber sashes in the same style, matching the current glazing pattern, with double-glazed units. The glazing will be of a “slimline heritage” type, with 4mm toughened PLANICLEAR glass panes sandwiching an 8mm krypton-filled cavity to yield an expected thermal transmission rate of 1.2 W/(m2K) and outdoor luminous reflectance of 13%.

The appearance of the new sashes and box frames will match that of the existing sashes and box frames using timber and the same glazing configuration. The new sashes will be constructed from sapele hardwood timber and painted white, internally and externally.

Drawings and photos are attached.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Location plan; MJ/LSWD/01; MJ/LSWD/10; MJ/LSWD/02; MJ/LSWD/03; MJ/LSWD/04; MJ/LSWD/05; MJ/LSWD/06; MJ/LSWD/07; MJ/LSWD/08; MJ/LSWD/09; Design and Access Statement.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. The replacement windows shown on the elevations and sections shall be white painted timber.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
